title.zh: 特朗普豁免俄柴油进口制裁，三艘油轮下周抵美引发法律争议
title.en: 特朗普豁免俄柴油进口制裁，三艘油轮下周抵美引发法律争议

current_state.zh: The Trump administration's sanctions waiver allows three tankers carrying about 140,000 tonnes of Russian diesel to arrive in the US in early November, prompting bipartisan congressional warnings over compliance with allied sanctions and national-security risks.
current_state.en: The Trump administration's sanctions waiver allows three tankers carrying about 140,000 tonnes of Russian diesel to arrive in the US in early November, prompting bipartisan congressional warnings over compliance with allied sanctions and national-security risks.
